exposure: Timing of delivery (early term vs full term)
outcome: Neonatal Critical Care Unit (NCCU) admission with serious morbidity
cohort: 22,954 viable singleton births by prelabor cesarean section at term (37-40 weeks) at a single center in Australia between 1998 and 2013
finding: Infants born in the public hospital had more adverse outcomes and treatment escalations, despite early-term prelabor cesarean sections occurring more often in the private hospital.
